properties.name: AUK Logistics
properties.description:
Innovative thinking, solutions-based freight forwarder.

AUK Logistics is a small robust team of logistics professionals, our management team combined has over 50 years of experience working for multinational forwarders, shipping lines, airlines, warehousing, ecommerce express parcel agency as well as a major minerals importer.

Together we have a 3-dimensional view in the whole supply chain with experience handling everything from LCL shipments to Heavy Lift machinery on breakbulk vessels. Our total transportation solution offers a complete service package whether you are shipping a minimum shipment by Air or 100 tons of project freight to on-site delivery.

Not just “desktop operators” we are an asset-based agency, having a dedicated fleet of vehicles coupled with our own warehouses that is integrated with Australian customs, we bring a powerful blend of door to door shipping, supply chain management services, ecommerce and last mile delivery.
